comics.description: In an age covered in eternal ice, a banished prince wields the legendary Frost Scepter to reclaim his throne from the flame tyrants.
comics.title: Rise of the Frost Monarch

comics.description: Join the universe's most notorious mercenary crew as they chase high-value targets across uncharted nebulae.
comics.title: Galactic Bounty Hunters
Legends of Shadow-Realm
comics.description: Uncover ancient curses and solve dark alchemical riddles alongside Detective Vance in a Victorian city covered in smoke and mystery.
Two AI engineers working on conflicting models find themselves falling in love through sweet, randomized chat algorithms.
comics.title: Love in the Digital Age

stories.content: Deep within the ancient whispers of Eldoria, a forgotten relic begins to glow. Elian, a young apprentice, discovers that his lineage traces back to the legendary Sky Wardens. Guided by an enigmatic map, he sets off across the floating cliffs of Aurelia, encountering celestial beasts and unlocking ancient runic magic. His destiny is to seal the Rift of Shadows before the next solar eclipse.
stories.partsJson: [{"id":1,"storyId":1,"partNumber":1,"title":"Part 1: The Call of Aurelia","content":"Elian sat in his workspace, watching the strange starlight crystal pulse softly. He had spent years reading legends, but this was different. The ancient runic text translated perfectly: 'When the sky-island shadows grow long, the rift opens.'"},{"id":2,"storyId":1,"partNumber":2,"title":"Part 2: The Floating Mountains","content":"Stepping off the air-skiff, Elian felt the ground shift. Aurelia's mountains were held by magnetic gravity. Lyra pointed to a glowing spire. 'There lies the Warden's seal. But hurry, the dark clouds are rising from the deep fissure.'"},{"id":3,"storyId":1,"partNumber":3,"title":"Part 3: The Sealed Gateway","content":"With the crystal in place, a wave of pure force swept through the canyon. The shadows hissed and dissolved back into the abyss. Elian turned to Lyra. 'It is done. For now, the rift is quiet.'"}]
stories.title: The Chronicles of Eldoria

stories.content: Takahiro wields the Plasma Katana, a relic of his ancestors in a futuristic high-tech Kyoto. When the corrupt Megacorp tries to seize the blade to power their superweapon, Takahiro must lead an underground rebellion to restore honor and protect the spiritual heart of his home.
stories.title: Neon Samurai Legacy
A Song for the Autumn
stories.content: A violinist who lost her hearing in an accident finds solace in painting. She meets a blind cellist who plays beautiful melodies on the street. Together, they create a sensory language of art and music that heals their broken hearts and bridges the gap between their quiet worlds.

stories.title: The Crimson Cipher
stories.content: An ancient leather-bound manuscript is found in a Vatican library vault. Professor Marcus spends nights decoding its crimson-ink symbols, only to realize the text predicts major historical events. As mysterious figures start trailing his family, he realizes the final page details an impending global catastrophe set to happen in 48 hours.

stories.title: The Dragon of Ironwood
stories.content: Ironwood is a land where trees are as strong as steel. A baby dragon, born with iron scales instead of fire, is found by a local lumberjack. Together, they defend the forest against an encroaching empire's strip-mining machines, showing that nature's strength is unbreakable.

stories.title: Infiltration of Sector 7
stories.content: An elite spy, Jax, is sent to infiltrate a submarine base in the arctic Sector 7. Equipped with state-of-the-art optical camouflage, he navigates laser grids and acoustic sensors only to find that the base is a decoy for a rogue missile launch scheduled from an orbiting satellite station.

stories.title: Summer Rain and Sunshine
stories.content: Mia runs an ice cream parlor that is struggling to survive a rainy summer. Liam, a cheerful weather reporter who always predicts sunshine, steps in to help her organize creative 'rainy day' specials, turning the shop into a cozy town favorite while falling deeply in love with her under their shared yellow umbrella.

stories.partsJson: [{"id":4,"storyId":2,"partNumber":1,"title":"Episode 1: Memory Infiltration","content":"Neon rain fell upon Neo-Tokyo. Kaelen ran his deck with trembling fingers. The memory core was hot, glowing under the blue mesh. 'Uploading now,' he muttered, while tactical sirens began to echo in the distance."},{"id":5,"storyId":2,"partNumber":2,"title":"Episode 2: Syndicate Retaliation","content":"Shattered glass showered the street. Kaelen rolled behind a neural-charging station. The AI, Iris, beeped. 'Rebellion channels activated. Cyborg strike team approaching.'"}]
stories.content: In the neon-drenched spires of Neo-Tokyo, information is the ultimate currency. Kaelen, a rogue cyber-runner, accidentally intercepts an encrypted memory core belonging to the city's omnipotent governing syndicate. Hunted by cyborg mercenary squads, he must team up with a mysterious artificial intelligence to upload the core to the global resistance network before the grid goes into complete lockdown.
stories.title: Cyber City Echoes

stories.content: Elena had always lived in the safety of her quiet bookstore, surrounded by paper worlds. That was until Julian, a nomadic travel photographer with a secret burden, walked in one rainy afternoon. As they spend the autumn exploring hidden city parks and sharing forgotten poetry, their lives interweave in ways they never expected, proving that sometimes the quietest love makes the loudest impact.
stories.partsJson: [{"id":6,"storyId":3,"partNumber":1,"title":"Chapter 1: The Book of Autumn","content":"Julian walked into Elena's cozy shop on a rainy Wednesday. His travel logs were drenched, but his eyes were bright with a strange story of the lost northern lakes. 'I think we can find them together,' he smiled."},{"id":7,"storyId":3,"partNumber":2,"title":"Chapter 2: Following the Compass","content":"Elena held the map to her face. 'The ink, Julian, look! It only shows up when under candlelight.' Their eyes met in the warm glow of the cozy back room of the bookstore."}]
stories.title: Whispers of the Heart

stories.partsJson: [{"id":8,"storyId":4,"partNumber":1,"title":"Act I: Copper Gears & Brass Keys","content":"The clock tower struck thirteen. Clara adjusted her lens. 'No mechanism should behave this way,' she murmured, tracing a strange alchemical residue on the central pendulum gear."},{"id":9,"storyId":4,"partNumber":2,"title":"Act II: Labyrinth of Shadows","content":"As she turned the brass key, the floorboards slid open. A hidden staircase wound deep under the town center. Clara stepped inside, her oil lamp casting long, distorted shadows."}]
stories.content: When the grand clock tower of Blackwood starts running backward, the townspeople panic. Detective Clara Vance is called to investigate and finds herself trapped in a shifting labyrinth of copper gears and dark alchemy. She must solve a centuries-old murder mystery encoded in the clock's pendulum before time runs out for everyone.
stories.title: The Haunted Clockwork
Journey through Shadow-glen
stories.partsJson: [{"id":10,"storyId":5,"partNumber":1,"title":"Chapter 1: The Seed of Hope","content":"Lyra packed her satchel with glowing moss. 'The path through Shadow-glen is dangerous,' warned the village elder. 'Do not wander off the luminescent trail.'"},{"id":11,"storyId":5,"partNumber":2,"title":"Chapter 2: Whispers in the Canopy","content":"In the dark branches, tiny eyes blinked. Rather than aiming her bow, Lyra offered a handful of honey-berries. A small, winged sprite emerged, bowing in gratitude and pointing toward the sacred grove."}]
stories.content: Shadow-glen was once a forest of pure light, but a dark curse withered its leaves. Lyra, an elven archer, is chosen to carry the Seed of Hope to the sacred grove at the forest's core. With monsters lurking in every shadow, she learns that her greatest weapon is not her bow, but the kindness she shows to the creatures of the woods.

Clara is a solar-sail racer, navigating the treacherous gravity wells of Jupiter. When her brother is captured by space pirates, she converts her lightweight racing ship into a stealth scout to infiltrate the pirate stronghold in the Asteroid Belt, leading to a thrilling high-speed chase across the rings of Saturn.
stories.partsJson: [{"id":12,"storyId":6,"partNumber":1,"title":"Section 1: Solar Wind Navigation","content":"The solar flare was registered at Class X. Clara pulled back the primary sail levers. 'Hold on tight!' she shouted, as the ship rode the superheated plasma wave at relativistic speeds."}]
stories.title: Rider of the Solar Winds
Starlight and Coffee Cups
stories.content: Two astrophysicists, Leo and Sarah, compete for the same research grant at the Royal Observatory. Bound by their passion for the stars but separated by professional rivalry, a shared discovery of a strange stellar anomaly forces them to work together under the starlit canopy, sparking an unexpected celestial romance.
stories.partsJson: [{"id":13,"storyId":7,"partNumber":1,"title":"Phase 1: Constellation Rivalry","content":"Sarah's thesis was impeccable. Leo's telescope findings were groundbreaking. They spent the first week of the summit pointing out flaws in each other's research, unaware of the cosmic anomaly currently aligning above them."}]

stories.title: The Last Train to Nowhere
stories.content: A group of strangers boards a midnight train from Paris. As they cross the countryside, they discover the train has no driver, the windows are completely blacked out, and one passenger has vanished from their locked cabin. To survive, they must uncover the secret connection that binds them all to a crime committed ten years ago.

stories.title: The Fire Mage's Daughter
stories.content: Ignis was the most powerful fire mage, but he left his staff to his daughter, Chloe, who can only conjure cold blue frost. Rejected by the Fire Academy, she travels to the Northern Ice Spires and discovers her frost is actually the only element capable of pacifying the ancient volcanic dragons sleeping under the earth.
